text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- U.S. President Bill Clinton meets visiting Crown Prince Mohamed.
- Morocco launches campaign to make more young voters register on electoral lists.
- Illiteracy likely to increase if free schooling is ended in Morocco.
- Human Rights League says in report that in 1996 Morocco backtracked on main issues.
- Interior Minister Driss Basri says the government's commitments on social benefits decided in August cannot be reversed.
